# Bidirectional layout

Adapted from the MIT-licensed [bidi-js](https://github.com/lojjic/bidi-js)
revision recorded in `upstream.json`. Original file hashes and download URLs
are retained there; the redistribution licence is `LICENSE.txt`.

Local adaptations:

- Character properties and bracket pairs come from our pinned Unicode 18 data,
  generated by `tools/unicode/build_tables.py`, including normative bidi defaults.
- All indices are Unicode scalar indices, including supplementary RTL scripts.
  The renderer adapter translates layout's UTF-16 offsets explicitly.
- Fixed `getReorderSegments`' trailing-whitespace slice index: use
  `i - lineStart`, not `i`, to implement L1 on wrapped substrings.
- Removed the unused string reversal/mirroring API. Native canvas shapes and
  mirrors logical directional runs; we do not reverse raw UTF-16 or glyphs.

`tests/bidi.test.mjs` checks both complete Unicode 18 bidi conformance corpora.
The paragraph algorithm passes their levels, base directions and L2 ordering.
`js/direction.js` adapts paragraph results into visual-order logical runs,
retaining shaping controls, with an explicit override per run so canvas does
not recalculate weak/neutral directions from only a soft-wrapped substring.

This validates the algorithm, not every font's glyph shapes or every browser's
shaping/mirroring. Browser fixtures compare representative unwrapped runs with
native whole-paragraph rendering, and wrapped fixtures exercise measurement,
ink bounds, balloons and PNG export. Cross-engine and linguistic review remain
part of the beta's broader validation work.
